title: Second-Order Conditions for Infinite-Horizon Semilinear Parabolic Control Problems without Tikhonov Regularization
summary: We consider semilinear parabolic optimal control problems subject to Neumann boundary conditions, control constraints, and an infinite time horizon. The control constraints are pointwise in time, but they can be pointwise or integral in the space variable. Crucially, the optimal control problem does not include a Tikhonov regularization in the cost functional, which provides a major difficulty in the extension of the classical finite-horizon theory to infinite-horizon optimal control problems.
